item.title: Forum: Littering seems to be on rise; let’s become ‘Litter Gitters’
item.description: Fed up with trash that others strew? Grab a bag and join our ‘small acts of resistance’ movement.

item.title: Forum: Protect kids from fentanyl, other dangerous drugs at home
item.description: Legislation to add fentanyl to an endangerment law died in the House. But Everett has stepped up.

item.title: Comment: State can’t ignore need after federal cuts to health care
item.description: State lawmakers must adjust the budget to make up for federal losses to Medicaid and long-term care.

item.title: Comment: Budget cuts threaten access, upkeep of state rec areas
item.description: A loss of funding would cut employees and force closures of DNR sites that state residents enjoy.

item.title: Comment: Proposed tax would hinder construction businesses
item.description: The ‘millionaires tax’ would hit the working capital that construction firms need to build communities.

item.title: Editorial: Protect state climate act’s funds for intended uses
item.description: The CCA fund’s shouldn’t go toward other needs. A better accounting of its spending is necessary

item.title: Editorial cartoons for Saturday, March 7

item.title: Snohomish girls basketball falls short in 3A state semis
item.description: The Panthers’ 18-game win streak ends with 47-43 loss to Eastside Catholic on Friday.

item.title: One person injured Friday in a shooting at Lynnwood Park
item.description: Lynnwood police discovered the victim a few blocks away at a neighbor’s house and transported them to Harborview Medical Center.

item.title: Raise a glass to Snohomish County’s best breweries
item.description: Readers voted for the local spot pouring the flavors and atmosphere they love most.
